title: H-SCHEDNULL-1: retiring a duty stand-in never leaves a shift with NO employee id behind. The mod's own strip now runs BEFORE the native unassign, so native's RemoveAllWorkShiftsThatMatchPredicate (which nulls employeeId before dropping the shift) finds nothing to match and nulls nothing. The host injects a duty synthetic at one of its own rented buildings and retires it through the real RemoveSynthetic path (DEV lever `schedfilter`), then the read-only `schednull` census must report dayNull=0. Also carries the M2 freeze-gate evidence for the host's load. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). Dev build with the levers settype / schedfilter / schednull (BAMP_DEV). The host must rent at least one registration with a business type - the `settype` discovery step fails loudly if none does. FIXTURE HYGIENE: nothing is saved.
